```{r setup, include=FALSE}

```

#Load Dataset and exclude M52_D4
```{r}

dds_mouse_filtered <- dds_mouse[, !(colnames(dds_mouse) %in% c("M52_D4"))]
```

#Run DESeq2 to get a ranking statistics for day 4, 6, and 11
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
dds4 <- dds_mouse_filtered[, dds_mouse_filtered$day==4]

# Remove genes with all zero counts in Day 4 samples
dds4 <- dds4[which(rowSums(dds4@assays@data@listData[["counts"]]) != 0),]
dds4

# Set group reference level
dds4$group <- factor(dds4$group, levels=c("Naive","Vaccinated"))
#Model gene expression as a function of group
design(dds4) <- ~ group
dds4 <- DESeq(dds4)


#Day 6
dds6 <- dds_mouse_filtered[, dds_mouse_filtered$day==6]
dds6 <- dds6[which(rowSums(dds6@assays@data@listData[["counts"]]) != 0),]
dds6$group <- factor(dds6$group, levels=c("Naive","Vaccinated"))
design(dds6) <- ~ group
dds6 <- DESeq(dds6)

#Day 11
dds11 <- dds_mouse_filtered[, dds_mouse_filtered$day==11]
dds11 <- dds11[which(rowSums(dds11@assays@data@listData[["counts"]]) != 0),]
dds11$group <- factor(dds11$group, levels=c("Naive","Vaccinated"))
design(dds11) <- ~ group
dds11 <- DESeq(dds11)

```


#GSEA Function for M7 and M8
```{r}
#============================================================
# Helper function: run full GSEA pipeline for one day
#============================================================
run_gsea_day <- function(dds_obj, day_label, pathways_m7, pathways_m8,
                         msig_m7, msig_m8, output_dir) {
  
  # --- 1. Extract ranked stats ---
  res <- results(dds_obj, contrast = c("group", "Vaccinated", "Naive"))
  rank <- res$stat
  names(rank) <- rownames(res)
  rank <- rank[!is.na(rank)]
  rank <- sort(rank, decreasing = TRUE)
  
  # --- 2. Diagnostics ---
  cat("\n=== Day", day_label, "===\n")
  cat("Duplicated gene names:", sum(duplicated(names(rank))), "\n")
  cat("Non-finite values:", sum(!is.finite(rank)), "\n")
  cat("Overlap with M7:", sum(names(rank) %in% unique(msig_m7$gene_symbol)), "\n")
  cat("Overlap with M8:", sum(names(rank) %in% unique(msig_m8$gene_symbol)), "\n")
  
  # --- 3. Run fgsea ---
  fgsea_m7 <- fgsea(pathways = pathways_m7, stats = rank,
                    minSize = 10, maxSize = 500) %>% arrange(padj)
  fgsea_m8 <- fgsea(pathways = pathways_m8, stats = rank,
                    minSize = 10, maxSize = 500) %>% arrange(padj)
  
  # --- 4. Summarize significance ---
  for (tag in c("M7", "M8")) {
    df <- if (tag == "M7") fgsea_m7 else fgsea_m8
    n_total <- nrow(df)
    n_sig   <- sum(df$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
    cat(tag, "Day", day_label, ":",
        n_sig, "/", n_total, "pathways significant (",
        round(n_sig / n_total * 100, 1), "% )\n")
  }
  
  # --- 5. Filter significant ---
  fgsea_m7_sig <- fgsea_m7 %>% dplyr::filter(padj < 0.05)
  fgsea_m8_sig <- fgsea_m8 %>% dplyr::filter(padj < 0.05)
  
  # --- 6. Top 10 up/down ---
  get_top10 <- function(df, direction) {
    if (direction == "up") {
      df %>% dplyr::filter(NES > 0) %>% dplyr::arrange(desc(NES)) %>%
        dplyr::select(pathway, NES, padj, size, leadingEdge) %>%
        dplyr::slice_head(n = 10)
    } else {
      df %>% dplyr::filter(NES < 0) %>% dplyr::arrange(NES) %>%
        dplyr::select(pathway, NES, padj, size, leadingEdge) %>%
        dplyr::slice_head(n = 10)
    }
  }
  
  top_m7 <- bind_rows(get_top10(fgsea_m7_sig, "up"),
                      get_top10(fgsea_m7_sig, "down"))
  top_m8 <- bind_rows(get_top10(fgsea_m8_sig, "up"),
                      get_top10(fgsea_m8_sig, "down"))
  
  # --- 7. Write CSVs ---
  write.csv(fgsea_m7_sig[, c("pathway","NES","padj","size")],
            file.path(output_dir, paste0("fgsea_m7_day", day_label, "_sig.csv")),
            row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(fgsea_m8_sig[, c("pathway","NES","padj","size")],
            file.path(output_dir, paste0("fgsea_m8_day", day_label, "_sig.csv")),
            row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(fgsea_m7[, c("pathway","NES","padj","size")],
            file.path(output_dir, paste0("fgsea_m7_day", day_label, "_clean.csv")),
            row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(fgsea_m8[, c("pathway","NES","padj","size")],
            file.path(output_dir, paste0("fgsea_m8_day", day_label, "_clean.csv")),
            row.names = FALSE)
  
  # --- 8. Return results for plotting ---
  list(
    fgsea_m7 = fgsea_m7, fgsea_m8 = fgsea_m8,
    fgsea_m7_sig = fgsea_m7_sig, fgsea_m8_sig = fgsea_m8_sig,
    top_m7 = top_m7, top_m8 = top_m8,
    rank = rank
  )
}


#============================================================
# Helper function: generate bar + dot plots for one day
#============================================================
plot_gsea_day <- function(results, day_label) {
  
  make_plot_df <- function(top_df) {
    top_df %>%
      mutate(direction = ifelse(NES > 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
             pathway = reorder(pathway, NES))
  }
  
  plot_m7 <- make_plot_df(results$top_m7)
  plot_m8 <- make_plot_df(results$top_m8)
  
  bar_plot <- function(df, collection) {
    ggplot(df, aes(x = pathway, y = NES, fill = direction)) +
      geom_col() +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(title = paste("Top enriched", collection, "pathways at Day", day_label),
           x = "Pathway", y = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Positive" = "steelblue", "Negative" = "tomato")) +
      theme_bw()
  }
  
  dot_plot <- function(df, collection) {
    ggplot(df, aes(x = NES, y = pathway)) +
      geom_point(aes(size = size, color = padj)) +
      scale_color_gradient(low = "tomato", high = "steelblue", trans = "reverse") +
      labs(title = paste("Top enriched", collection, "pathways at Day", day_label),
           x = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)", y = "Pathway",
           size = "Gene set size", color = "Adjusted p-value") +
      theme_bw()
  }
  
  print(bar_plot(plot_m7, "M7"))
  print(bar_plot(plot_m8, "M8"))
  print(dot_plot(plot_m7, "M7"))
  print(dot_plot(plot_m8, "M8"))
}


#============================================================
# Run all three days
#============================================================
output_dir <- "/work/users/x/c/xczhou/Chlamydia/Analysis Outputs"

results_d4 <- run_gsea_day(dds4, "4", pathways_m7, pathways_m8,
                            msig_m7, msig_m8, output_dir)
results_d6 <- run_gsea_day(dds6, "6", pathways_m7, pathways_m8,
                            msig_m7, msig_m8, output_dir)
results_d11 <- run_gsea_day(dds11, "11", pathways_m7, pathways_m8,
                             msig_m7, msig_m8, output_dir)


#============================================================
# Plot all three days
#============================================================
plot_gsea_day(results_d4, "4")
plot_gsea_day(results_d6, "6")
plot_gsea_day(results_d11, "11")
```




#GSEAS function for KEGG
```{r}
run_kegg_day <- function(rank, day_label, output_dir) {
  
  # Convert symbols to Entrez IDs
  gene_df <- bitr(names(rank), fromType = "SYMBOL",
                  toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db)
  gene_df <- gene_df[!duplicated(gene_df$SYMBOL), ]  # remove duplicate mappings
  
  # Diagnostics
  cat("\n=== KEGG Day", day_label, "===\n")
  cat("Total genes:", length(rank), "\n")
  cat("Matched:", nrow(gene_df), "\n")
  cat("Unmatched:", length(rank) - nrow(gene_df), "\n")
  
  # Build Entrez-named rank vector
  rank_kegg <- rank[gene_df$SYMBOL]
  names(rank_kegg) <- gene_df$ENTREZID
  rank_kegg <- sort(rank_kegg, decreasing = TRUE)
  
  # Run gseKEGG
  gsea_kegg <- gseKEGG(
    geneList     = rank_kegg,
    organism     = "mmu",
    minGSSize    = 10,
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    eps          = 0,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH"
  )
  
  # Convert to data frame
  kegg_df <- as.data.frame(gsea_kegg) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    dplyr::select(Description, NES, p.adjust, setSize)
  
  # Write CSVs
  write.csv(kegg_df,
            file.path(output_dir, paste0("kegg_day", day_label, "_clean.csv")),
            row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(kegg_df %>% slice_head(n = 10),
            file.path(output_dir, paste0("kegg_day", day_label, "_top10.csv")),
            row.names = FALSE)
  
  # Top 10 up/down for plotting
  top_up   <- kegg_df %>% dplyr::filter(NES > 0) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(NES)) %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = 10)
  top_down <- kegg_df %>% dplyr::filter(NES < 0) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(NES) %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = 10)
  
  plot_df <- bind_rows(top_up, top_down) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(direction = ifelse(NES > 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
                  Description = reorder(Description, NES))
  
  list(kegg_df = kegg_df, plot_df = plot_df)
}


plot_kegg_day <- function(results, day_label) {
  
  bar <- ggplot(results$plot_df, aes(x = Description, y = NES, fill = direction)) +
    geom_col() + coord_flip() +
    labs(title = paste("Top enriched KEGG pathways at Day", day_label),
         x = "Pathway", y = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Positive" = "steelblue", "Negative" = "tomato")) +
    theme_bw()
  
  dot <- ggplot(results$plot_df, aes(x = NES, y = Description)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = setSize, color = p.adjust)) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "tomato", high = "steelblue", trans = "reverse") +
    labs(title = paste("Top enriched KEGG pathways at Day", day_label),
         x = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)", y = "Pathway",
         size = "Gene set size", color = "Adjusted p-value") +
    theme_bw()
  
  print(bar)
  print(dot)
}


# Run all three days
output_dir <- "/work/users/x/c/xczhou/Chlamydia/Analysis Outputs"

kegg_d4  <- run_kegg_day(results_d4$rank,  "4",  output_dir)
kegg_d6  <- run_kegg_day(results_d6$rank,  "6",  output_dir)
kegg_d11 <- run_kegg_day(results_d11$rank, "11", output_dir)

plot_kegg_day(kegg_d4,  "4")
plot_kegg_day(kegg_d6,  "6")
plot_kegg_day(kegg_d11, "11")
```
